hypothesis_and_architecture.formulation: theta_c = g_phi(X_c) -> active mask m_s -> active theta -> Torch-FUSE Lite

training_specification.structure_sampling: Shuffled legal 78-structure permutation per cycle, exactly once per structure per cycle
training_specification.basin_sampling: GlobalBasinSampler over 12 target basins with B=100 windows

diagnostic_sweeps.no_update_invariant: Zero optimizer steps during diagnostic sweeps; parameters verified bitwise unchanged

diagnostic_batch.selection_rule: Stratified deterministic hydrologically diverse forcing windows across all 12 basins covering dry/wet/snow-active regimes

conflict_metrics_and_thresholds.gradient_target: partial L_s / partial u_{b,j} (normalized pre-transform coordinate space)
conflict_metrics_and_thresholds.sign_conflict_formula: C_{b,j} = 2 * min(P_{b,j}, N_{b,j}) / (P_{b,j} + N_{b,j}) where P=sum(max(g,0)), N=sum(max(-g,0))
conflict_metrics_and_thresholds.structure_dominance_formula: N_eff = (sum |g_s|)^2 / sum(g_s^2), normalized as N_eff / N_active
conflict_metrics_and_thresholds.persistent_conflict_definition: A parameter is PERSISTENT_STRONG_CONFLICT if at D1, D3, D5: signal_support >= 0.25, median C >= 0.30, and normalized N_eff >= 0.20

gate_decision_rules.Gate_A: conflict_fraction <= 0.10 -> Pure sharing supported for next stage; keep pure shared + active mask
gate_decision_rules.Gate_B: 0.10 < conflict_fraction <= 0.30 -> Localized conflict; investigate flagged parameters for process-option interactions
gate_decision_rules.Gate_C: conflict_fraction > 0.30 -> Broad conflict; discuss structure-conditioned parameterization
gate_decision_rules.Inconclusive_Rule: If > 30% of canonical shared parameters have signal_support < 0.25 -> INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_SIGNAL
